## About
Gulf-Tex Roofing & Services is a roofing contractor based on Bailey Rd in Manvel, TX. We put on new roofs and take care of repairs and maintenance for homeowners around the area.
Our neighbors have given us a 5 star rating across 74 Google reviews. What people tend to mention is the way the crew works hard, keeps them in the loop, and leaves the yard clean when the job is done.

## Services
- New roofs: New roofs for homes, from picking colors to final cleanup.
- Roof repairs and maintenance: Repairs and maintenance work, including for homeowners getting a house ready to sell.
